title: MATCH PARCELS TO TEMPLATE BY NAME
description: For each parcel name in the template mapping, find that name in an input cifti file and use its data in the output file.  All input cifti files must have a parcels mapping along <modify-direction> and matching mappings along other dimensions.  The direction can be either an integer starting from 1, or the strings 'ROW' or 'COLUMN'.

cifti_template.description: a cifti file with the template parcel mapping along column

modify_direction.description: which dimension of the output file should match the template (integer, 'ROW', or 'COLUMN')

fill_value.description: specify value to be used in parcels that don't match
